subtitle: Sovereign Tree Overhaul — Ascendant Visual Foundation
changes: Introduced optional Ascendant View: an original premium fantasy skill-tree presentation over the established Talent Atlas.
Added visually distinctive source-structure node types for connected hubs, multi-rank talents, standard nodes and choice talents, without inventing gameplay rarity or official capstones.
Enhanced visible Blizzard-reported branch paths with glowing gold links for planned endpoints and cyan highlights for partially planned routes.
Added a small expandable node legend and a concise tree status HUD; the enhanced appearance can be switched off instantly.
Preserved the existing official talent node positions and IDs, rank allocation, undo/redo, preview inspector, wheel zoom, drag panning, fullscreen controls, media and private saves.
